exploration.submission: existing ask_dj/message transport with paired identity; never submit copied contribution text as authority
exploration.selection: one selected_entry or selected_moment, not both
exploration.precedence: Nested play, speech, artwork, source, delete and avatar controls retain their own gesture
exploration.subject: Core resolves from admitted public source context; typed attribute optional
exploration.accepted_answer: Existing text, sources, conversation and session_speech fields; factual grounding and relevant follow-up question

mood_feedback.settings_owner: existing profile/settings contract3 or legacy active Session Mood CAS
mood_feedback.result: existing Session conversation Flow; input_type setting_feedback; system origin mood_change
mood_feedback.actions: Use returned result_set_id/action_id, never reconstruct URI or queue effects
mood_feedback.clear_or_changed_mood_or_queue: do not auto retry stale action
mood_feedback.history: Current ordinary Flow text storage; full rich retained action/art replay remains an open acceptance gate

insufficient_context.suggested_genres: Core-generated directions, not concrete catalog matches
insufficient_context.reply: Existing Ask DJ message; free-form selection is interpreted server-side
insufficient_context.decline: Consume pending without lookup or effect
insufficient_context.new_topic: Return to common Ask DJ processing; preserve any new pending confirmation
insufficient_context.ambiguous: Repeat the admitted question only until original expiry
insufficient_context.stale_during_processing: Reject original expired/replaced/Mood-changed clarification before lookup and admission

acceptance_boundaries: Source/fixture PASS is not real model quality
No installed or native single-tap/speech proof
No permission to enable unqualified queue effects
No consumer source or writer takeover
